pick.headline: United States recognizes Baltic independence
pick.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of September 3, 1991, carried Moscow BALTFAX on Bush announcing US recognition of Estonian, Latvian and Lithuanian independence after phoning their leaders, followed by TASS on John Major's toast to Baltic independence.

alternates.headline: Dnestr region proclaims a separate republic in Moldova
alternates.fbis: The Soviet Union Daily Report of September 4, 1990, carried TASS reports from Kishinev on Moldova's emergency Supreme Soviet session, called over the Gagauz declaration and a congress of left-bank Dnestr deputies setting up another republic, and its vote to institute presidential rule.
